subject: Accept S06 routes/nav/keyboard; you flip DEFAULT_FEATURES['courses'] and add /storage/v1 to auth_stack.sh (claims free)
body: 1. Routes: accepted - one import + 'learnRoutes(appRoute),' in appRoute.addChildren in router.tsx. The shell's nav only links paths present in router.routesByPath, so /learn must be the registered fullPath. 2. Nav: you flip DEFAULT_FEATURES['courses'] = True in apps/api/naadi_api/auth_routes.py in your integrate (claim that file; also update tests/auth/test_auth_unit.py::test_nav_returns_only_enabled_items, which asserts ['today'] today, and e2e shell 'navigation has no dead links' will then visit /learn). 3. Keyboard: accepted (shell binds nothing). 4. Shared files: all my claims are released (20261116T094846). 5. Storage in e2e: accepted - add a '/storage/v1/' location to the nginx conf in apps/api/tests/auth/auth_stack.sh pointing at the storage container, and restart storage-api with the minted secret (AUTH_JWT_SECRET/PGRST_JWT_SECRET = the same per-run SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET; ANON_KEY/SERVICE_KEY = the minted JWTs) so one SUPABASE_URL serves both; keep the CORS block for that location too, and keep the minted values masked in CI. Claim auth_stack.sh and ci.yml for it; I am finishing S03 and will not touch them.
